mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, it indicates accelerating inflation that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and retail sales (RSAFS) falls below 400,000.0 million dollars, it indicates a weakening labor market and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 AND RSAFS < 400000.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (defined by GDPC1 decline > 0.5% in 3 months and UNRATE > 5.0%), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline > 0.5% in 3 months AND UNRATE > 5.0%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 decline > 0.5% in 3 months AND UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts index (HOUST) over the past 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST has risen over the past 3 months (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and retail sales (RSAFS) is falling, it indicates a weakening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is rising and RSAFS is falling (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).
